title: Cross-Reference Intelligence Findings
methodology: Algorithmic cross-referencing of 5 government datasets: OpenParliament (151 bills, 94 votes, 340 MPs), Commissioner of Lobbying (547K contacts), Elections Canada (6.2M contributions), CRA charity filings, and open.canada.ca procurement (3,133 contracts). Correlation does not imply causation.

finding_1_cija_pipeline.title: CIJA Lobby-to-Vote Pipeline
finding_1_cija_pipeline.summary: The Centre for Israel and Jewish Affairs is the 3rd most active lobbying org in Canada (2,138 communications) and the ONLY foreign-state-linked org in the top 15. 107 lobby sessions occurred post-Oct 7 2023 specifically targeting arms export policy.

evidence.fact: 107 CIJA lobby sessions post-Oct 7 on arms exports
CIJA is co-defendant in Dattani defamation lawsuit
Irwin Cotler received CIJA Lifetime Award while serving as Special Envoy
Bill C-233 (arms export restrictions) failed 22-295 — all lobbied MPs voted NO

finding_1_cija_pipeline.pattern: Lobby → Vote alignment: CIJA's most-lobbied MPs all voted to maintain unrestricted arms exports to Israel

finding_2_poilievre_network.title: CPC Leader — 12-Connection Foreign Influence Network
finding_2_poilievre_network.summary: Pierre Poilievre has 12 documented connections in the investigation graph spanning Israel advocacy, media amplification, firearms lobby, and bot networks.

evidence.fact: Led CPC bloc NAY on Gaza ceasefire Vote #658
Jerusalem embassy pledge to Canada-Israel Inter-Parliamentary Group
Deputy Leader Melissa Lantsman lobbied by CIJA 15x
CAAD Bot Network provides pro-Poilievre amplification
Handshake with Jeremy MacKenzie (Diagolon movement leader)
Moose on the Loose account produces pro-Poilievre content

finding_3_sidewinder_survivors.title: Project Sidewinder Subjects Still in Lobbying Pipeline
finding_3_sidewinder_survivors.summary: 4 parliamentarians named in the 1997 CSIS Project Sidewinder investigation into CCP influence were still sitting MPs during the 2022 Emergencies Act. 1 (Wayne Easter) also appears in the top lobbied officials list with 713 meetings.
finding_3_sidewinder_survivors.pattern: CSIS identified CCP influence vectors in 1997. The investigation was buried. The named parliamentarians continued serving for 25+ years.

finding_4_procurement_capture.title: Vendor Capture — Live Anomaly Scan
finding_4_procurement_capture.summary: 39 vendor concentration anomalies detected from 3,133 live government contracts on open.canada.ca. 26 classified as HIGH severity. Multiple vendors hold 95-100% of entire department budgets.

finding_5_charity_revocations.title: CRA Charity Revocation Cascade
finding_5_charity_revocations.summary: 7 Canadian charities have had tax-exempt status revoked since August 2024 for funneling funds to Israeli settlements, military, and occupation infrastructure. $276M flowed to Israel in 2024 alone through Canadian registered charities.

revocations.name: CZCA
revocations.finding: Increasing efficiency of foreign armed forces (IDF)

finding_5_charity_revocations.pattern: CRA's own 358-page report on JNF documented 'repeated and serious non-compliance'. Despite this, the charity operated for 20+ years before revocation. CZCA was explicitly found to be funding the IDF — a violation of the Foreign Enlistment Act.

finding_6_liberal_dissent.title: Liberal Party Dissent on Arms Exports
finding_6_liberal_dissent.summary: Bill C-233 (amending Export and Import Permits Act) failed 22-295. Only NDP and Green voted YES. 9.7% of Liberal MPs broke party line to vote YES — the highest intra-party dissent of the entire 45th Parliament.

vote_details.description: An Act to amend the Export and Import Permits Act

finding_6_liberal_dissent.context: This vote occurred after CIJA's 107 post-Oct 7 lobbying sessions specifically targeting arms export policy. The 9.7% Liberal dissent represents MPs who voted against their party's position AND against the lobbying pressure.

finding_7_lobbying_sector_dominance.title: Sector Lobbying Dominance Analysis
finding_7_lobbying_sector_dominance.summary: Oil & Gas sector leads with 5,579 communications from 4 companies. CIJA alone (2,138) outranks the entire banking sector (1,637), all pharma combined (1,982), and rivals all 3 telecoms combined (3,987).
finding_7_lobbying_sector_dominance.pattern: A single foreign-state-linked advocacy org matches or exceeds entire domestic industry sectors in lobbying volume

finding_8_contribution_asymmetry.title: Political Contribution Asymmetry
finding_8_contribution_asymmetry.summary: $1.25 billion in tracked political contributions. Conservative Party receives 46.8% ($586M) — nearly double the Liberal Party (30.2%, $378M). NDP receives 14.4% ($180M).
